review_scope: 10 clips / 78 formal frames / 78 runtime frames, their complete contact sheets, master-versus-64-color comparisons, facing contacts, neck self-repair comparison, GIF views and same-screen idle/walk/idle sequence
internal_review: The original head/face/cap/glasses remain tied together. New actions use existing source pixel limbs and fixed-anchor transforms; no per-frame AI or rejected SVG head is used.
self_repairs: Cheer independent head lift exposed a visible two-row neck gap: the recorded 20 empty core neck pixels became 0 after restoring the attached head and using a whole-body hop.
Cheer was revised from a low sideways indication to a near-arm celebratory lift, keeping elbow/shoulder source overlap intact.
The 48px family now shares one crop, scale, anchor and palette. Six-frame eye-midpoint-registered source turns replace the abrupt facing swap; endpoint poses are pixel-identical to idle/walk.
The hand formerly claimed by the satchel mask is now independent. The occluded far arm stays inside available source overlap instead of synthesizing hidden anatomy.
remaining_visual_limits: Turn midposes retain some full-size dissolve softness; they are registered original-view blends rather than new 3D rotation drawings.
Sad is a restrained head/shoulder slump with the original neutral face; new sad eyes or mouth were not invented.
Welcome uses the intact original neutral mouth and gentle nod/invitation. Voice timing is synchronized narration, not phoneme lip sync.
The 64-color large-frame deliverables visibly posterize smooth source shading; lossless masters and final-size comparisons keep this difference inspectable.
Background extraction slightly re-rendered the approved outfit board and retained faint fringe; source SHA and alpha thresholds remain explicit.
welcome_timing: Original WAV independently read as 43050 samples / 16000Hz = 2.690625s. WebAudio host preview schedules at +1.400s; two 16-frame/12fps cycles plus 23.958ms neutral hold cover the voice. HTML JavaScript syntax was checked; browser audio playback and real-device timing are separate checks.
technical_reproducibility: 441 generated files reproduced byte-for-byte in an isolated scratch tree; 41 GIF files decoded for timing. Frozen live PNGs were not rewritten during the check.
acceptance_boundary: Internal visual/self-repair review and saved-file checks do not imply human or on-device acceptance. They do not block the authorized next production round.
